missing-file.input: No config.ini, pens.ini or hotkeys.ini exists in the fixture directory.
missing-file.expected: Settings::defaults() (the code defaults used when the legacy files are completely absent); warnings: none; import succeeds and creates no file.
missing-file.distinct_from_factory: See default/expected.json. Pen3/Pen7 colours, Toolbar_Height, Allow_Dragging_Toolbar, Allow_Hotkey_In_Pointer_Mode and the non-global hotkeys differ on purpose.
missing-file.save: only to the new plnk settings path; legacy_paths_touched: false

missing-keys.input: config.ini has only Language_File; pens.ini has one Pen1 group; hotkeys.ini is empty.
missing-keys.expected: Present valid keys are imported; every absent key falls back to the code default. Missing keys are not warnings; only invalid values warn (P-172, spec 6.4).

settings.config_icons: code defaults (Eraser/Pan/Pointer/InkVisible/Snapshot/Undo/Clear true, PenWidth false, CanvasCursor arrow, AllowDragging true, AllowHotkeyInPointerMode true, ToolbarHeight 0.06, CloseOnSnap blank_only)
settings.hotkeys: code defaults (Global Ctrl + Alt + G, SnapPin Ctrl + Alt + Shift + P, all others None)

missing-keys.save: only to the new plnk settings path; legacy_paths_touched: false

invalid-values.input: Ranges, booleans, floats, Close_On_Snap and a two-digit pen id are invalid.
invalid-values.expected: Each invalid value falls back for that key and appends a SettingsWarning with the key name; valid values still import.

settings.white_tray_icon_note: First set to True, then 'maybe'; legacy White_Tray_Icon sets false for every value other than True/1/ON, so the final value is false and a warning is recorded.

pen1.note: alpha 999 is out of range; blue 200 is valid

settings.pen10_red: PEN10_RED is an invalid pen id (D-023); it must not change Pen1 and must warn

invalid-values.save: only to the new plnk settings path; legacy_paths_touched: false

syntax.input: Section headers, all legacy comment prefixes, blank lines, lowercase keys with extra spaces, duplicate keys, unknown keys, and a value containing a second '='.
syntax.expected: Section/comment lines are skipped and preserved; keys are trimmed and uppercased; the later duplicate wins; unknown lines are preserved; a line whose value contains '=' is skipped entirely.
syntax.save: Saving after import must preserve every comment, section header, blank and unknown line verbatim and only rewrite recognised keys; legacy_paths_touched: false.

encoding.input: config.ini is UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF and a non-ASCII path value; pens.ini is UTF-8 without BOM and LF; hotkeys.ini is UTF-8 without BOM and CRLF.
encoding.expected: All files parse as UTF-8; the BOM does not become part of the first key; line endings do not change semantics.
encoding.save: only to the new plnk settings path; legacy_paths_touched: false

hotkeys.input: None, Ctrl combos, F1-F12, NumPad names, spacing variants and two invalid values (Ctrl +, F13).
hotkeys.expected: Every valid hotkey parses and round-trips through display; F10-F12 work (D-001 fixed); NumPad uses stable readable names (D-002 fixed); an invalid value rolls back the whole hotkey with a key-name warning (D-003 fixed).
hotkeys.save: only to the new plnk settings path; legacy_paths_touched: false
